karees_mass_hero_ta.name: Karees Mass Hero (ta)
karees_mass_hero_ta.source: ElevenLabs voice design from a style description (not a clone of any person)
karees_mass_hero_ta.description: Adult Tamil man in his late twenties, voice actor dubbing a funny pet cat for YouTube Shorts. Medium-high male pitch, not childlike, not female. Wildly expressive and animated: big rises and falls, dramatic mass-hero swagger, mock-serious build-ups, cheeky teasing. Natural conversational pace, not rushed. Colloquial Chennai Tamil, close-mic studio recording.
